note: Mutants of how the match history finds the map of a recording and when it is let in (docs/REPLAYS.md "The match history", docs/MAP_SUBMISSIONS.md "Older games and big maps": The history), for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md). Run from the checkout with a configured build folder: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/history_approved_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 900. Every mutant must be caught: a match on an approved map of the players is counted whatever letter case its recording names the map in and its play shows on the map's entry, a match that a person played is counted while the server's own match of computer players runs, and nothing is counted while a room with a person in it loads or runs.
